summary: Phase 14.1 + 14.2 (iter408 · Dispatch Assignment Issuance Refinement + Haul Type continuity) end-to-end validated. Backend parity-lock 104/104 PASS (15 new iter408 + 7 iter407 + 82 historical iter319/392/393/395/396/401/402). All seeded vocabulary (sources, destinations, pickup_locations, dropoff_locations, materials with categories, haul_types, equipment_examples, carriers MASCI-first) returned on empty tenant with source='seed'; historical merge tags returned source='history' after POST. POST /api/dispatch/assignments accepts haul_type + equipment_id/label + pickup/dropoff_location + trailer_id/label + carrier; legacy POST defaults haul_type='Material'; no internal _* leakage. Frontend: /dispatch-portal/board shows board-create-assignment; drawer ac-haul-type-group renders all 4 buttons (material, equipment-move, spoils-dump, support-misc); Material mode shows ac-source/destination/material and hides ac-equipment/pickup/dropoff; Equipment Move mode reverses that; truck combobox loads 40 master options (seed slice cap of 40 in ComboboxField); ac-truck-add-temp + ac-equipment-add-temp surface for non-matching typed values; submit button label flips to 'Issue equipment move' in EM mode; end-to-end EM submission (temp truck T-EM-TEST + temp equipment EX-99 + pickup '415 Yard' + dropoff 'Job Site') creates a new ASSIGNED row tagged 'Equipment Move' on the board; iter407 T-99TEST row preserved.

issues: Cosmetic (carry-over from iter407 report): once a combobox value is selected the testid transitions from 'ac-<field>' to 'ac-<field>-selected'; testers must use the -selected suffix or re-clear to access the input. Already documented. No functional impact.

ComboboxField.filtered slices options at 40 when query is empty — exactly meets the 'shows 40+' acceptance criterion at the floor; typing narrows further so the equipment_master master records beyond 40 are still reachable via search. Consider raising the cap or rendering a 'show more' affordance if reviewers want >40 visible on cold-click.

critical_code_review_comments: dispatch_assignment_seeds.py (223 lines) — clean, single-purpose module; canonical vocabulary correctly decoupled from server.py; doctrine (no new collections / no new write endpoints) preserved.

AssignmentCreateDrawer.jsx (716 lines) — close to the 700-line guideline ceiling; ComboboxField subcomponent and conditional Haul Type field rendering are well-organized; future iter could extract ComboboxField + form-state hook into separate files if more haul types or field-sets land.

Lookups endpoint correctly merges seed + history with explicit 'source' flag; tenant isolation verified; no _id or _* leakage in any of the 11 lookup categories (drivers/trucks/trailers/equipment/carriers/projects/sources/destinations/pickup_locations/dropoff_locations/materials).

POST /api/dispatch/assignments correctly defaults haul_type='Material' for legacy callers; new additive fields persist on the assignment doc; backward compatibility confirmed by test_material_assignment_defaults_haul_type.
